---
title: "Manuscript Figures"
format: html
---

Publication figures for H1 (within-person condition effects) and H2 (trust and
acceptance predicting satisfaction). Model results come from
`inferential.qmd`, which must be rendered first. Figures are written to
`figures/` as vector PDF and 600 dpi PNG at full-page width (6.5 in).

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)

res <- read_rds(here::here("output", "inferential_results.rds"))
outcome_labels <- res$outcome_labels

dir.create(here::here("figures"), showWarnings = FALSE)

theme_apa <- function(base_size = 10) {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size, base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      text = element_text(colour = "black"),
      axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.4),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.4, colour = "black"),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold"),
      panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
      legend.box.spacing = unit(4, "pt"),
      plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = base_size + 1)
    )
}

save_figure <- function(plot, name, width, height) {
  ggsave(
    here::here("figures", paste0(name, ".pdf")),
    plot, width = width, height = height, units = "in", device = cairo_pdf
  )
  ggsave(
    here::here("figures", paste0(name, ".png")),
    plot, width = width, height = height, units = "in", dpi = 600,
    device = ragg::agg_png
  )
}
```

## Figure 1: Within-participant effect of not being asked for consent

Panel A shows each participant's observed mean rating in the vignettes where
they were asked versus not asked (thin lines), with the mean across
participants and its 95% CI. Panel B shows the within-person effect from the
H1b mixed models (adjusted for vignette), with 95% CIs (thin) and 90% CIs
(thick; the interval used for the equivalence tests).

```{r}
#| label: fig1-data

person_condition <- res$mm_data |>
  pivot_longer(names(outcome_labels), names_to = "measure", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(measure = factor(outcome_labels[measure], levels = outcome_labels)) |>
  summarise(value = mean(value), .by = c(ResponseId, measure, condition))

condition_means <- person_condition |>
  summarise(
    mean = mean(value),
    se = sd(value) / sqrt(n()),
    n = n(),
    .by = c(measure, condition)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    conf_low = mean - qt(0.975, n - 1) * se,
    conf_high = mean + qt(0.975, n - 1) * se
  )

within_effects <- res$h1b_tost |>
  mutate(measure = factor(measure, levels = rev(outcome_labels)))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig1
#| fig-width: 6.5
#| fig-height: 5.5

fig1a <- ggplot(person_condition, aes(x = condition, y = value)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = ResponseId), colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbar(
    data = condition_means,
    aes(y = mean, ymin = conf_low, ymax = conf_high),
    width = 0.12, linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_line(data = condition_means, aes(y = mean, group = 1), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = condition_means, aes(y = mean), size = 2.4) +
  facet_wrap(vars(measure)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(1, 5), breaks = 1:5) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = 0.3)) +
  labs(x = "Condition", y = "Mean rating (1–5)") +
  theme_apa()

fig1b <- ggplot(within_effects, aes(x = estimate, y = measure)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = ci90_low, xmax = ci90_high), linewidth = 1.6) +
  geom_point(size = 2.6, shape = 21, fill = "white", stroke = 0.8) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-0.5, 0.5), breaks = seq(-0.5, 0.5, 0.25)) +
  labs(
    x = "Within-participant effect of not being asked (scale points)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_apa()

fig1 <- fig1a / fig1b +
  plot_layout(heights = c(2.2, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")

fig1
save_figure(fig1, "figure1_h1_within", width = 6.5, height = 5.5)
```

**Suggested caption.** *Figure 1. Trust, Acceptance, and Satisfaction When
Participants Were or Were Not Asked for Consent.* (A) Thin lines show each
participant's mean rating in vignettes in which they were asked for consent
and in which they were not (*N* = 58). Black points and error bars show the
mean across participants and its 95% CI. (B) Within-participant effect of not
being asked (Not asked − Asked) from linear mixed models controlling for
vignette. Thin bars are 95% CIs and thick bars are 90% CIs (used for the
equivalence tests). Negative values indicate lower ratings when not asked, the
hypothesized direction.

## Figure 2: Trust and acceptance as predictors of satisfaction

Fixed-effect estimates from the H2 mixed models, with trust and acceptance
each split into within-participant (deviation from the participant's own
mean) and between-participant (participant mean) components. Open points:
each predictor entered on its own; filled points: both entered together.

```{r}
#| label: fig2-data

h2_terms <- c(
  trust_w = "Trust (within)",
  trust_pm = "Trust (between)",
  accept_w = "Acceptance (within)",
  accept_pm = "Acceptance (between)"
)

h2_plot_data <- res$h2 |>
  filter(term %in% names(h2_terms)) |>
  mutate(
    entry = if_else(model == "Both", "Entered jointly", "Entered separately"),
    entry = factor(entry, levels = c("Entered separately", "Entered jointly")),
    term = factor(h2_terms[term], levels = rev(h2_terms)),
    # Offset the two estimates for each term vertically
    y = as.numeric(term) + if_else(entry == "Entered jointly", -0.15, 0.15)
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: fig2
#| fig-width: 6.5
#| fig-height: 3.2

fig2 <- ggplot(h2_plot_data, aes(x = estimate, y = y, shape = entry)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(size = 2.4, fill = "white", stroke = 0.8) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Entered separately" = 21, "Entered jointly" = 16)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq_along(levels(h2_plot_data$term)),
    labels = levels(h2_plot_data$term),
    expand = expansion(add = 0.4)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-0.25, 1.25), breaks = seq(-0.25, 1.25, 0.25)) +
  labs(
    x = "Change in satisfaction per 1-point increase in predictor (95% CI)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_apa()

fig2
save_figure(fig2, "figure2_h2_satisfaction", width = 6.5, height = 3.2)
```

**Suggested caption.** *Figure 2. Within- and Between-Participant Associations
of Trust and Acceptance With Satisfaction.* Unstandardized fixed-effect
estimates and 95% CIs from linear mixed models predicting satisfaction
(*N* = 174 observations from 58 participants), controlling for condition and
vignette, with a random intercept for participant. Within-participant
components are deviations from the participant's mean across vignettes;
between-participant components are participant means. Open points show
estimates with trust or acceptance entered alone; filled points show estimates
with both entered together.

## Figure 3: Ratings by consent status (exploratory)

Group-level means for each consent status, adjusted for vignette, with 95% CIs
from cluster-robust standard errors (by participant). Grey points are
individual observations (jittered). The dashed line marks the Not asked mean in
each panel, so the vertical distance from it to each group shows that group's
gap from Not asked.

```{r}
#| label: fig3-data

# Two-line axis labels with the number of observations
status_labels <- res$status_data |>
  count(status) |>
  mutate(
    label = case_match(
      as.character(status),
      "Not asked" ~ "Not\nasked",
      "Consented to both" ~ "Consented\nto both",
      "Mixed" ~ "Mixed\n",
      "Declined both" ~ "Declined\nboth"
    ),
    label = paste0(label, "\n(n = ", n, ")")
  ) |>
  select(status, label) |>
  deframe()

status_points <- res$status_data |>
  pivot_longer(names(outcome_labels), names_to = "measure", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(measure = factor(outcome_labels[measure], levels = outcome_labels))

not_asked_ref <- res$status_means |>
  filter(status == "Not asked") |>
  select(measure, mean)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig3
#| fig-width: 6.5
#| fig-height: 3.6

set.seed(6317)

fig3 <- ggplot(res$status_means, aes(x = status, y = mean)) +
  geom_hline(
    data = not_asked_ref,
    aes(yintercept = mean),
    linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4, colour = "grey40"
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    data = status_points,
    aes(y = value),
    width = 0.15, height = 0.06, size = 0.7, colour = "grey70"
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = conf_low, ymax = conf_high), width = 0.15, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(size = 2.4) +
  facet_wrap(vars(measure)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = status_labels) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.9, 5.1), breaks = 1:5) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Rating (1–5)") +
  theme_apa(base_size = 9)

fig3
save_figure(fig3, "figure3_status_means", width = 6.5, height = 3.6)
```

**Suggested caption.** *Figure 3. Trust, Acceptance, and Satisfaction by
Consent Status.* Black points and error bars show means and 95% CIs for
vignettes in which participants were not asked for consent and, among
vignettes in which they were asked, by their response to the two consent
requests (consented to both, consented to one [mixed], declined both).
Means are adjusted for vignette, and CIs use cluster-robust standard errors
by participant (174 observations from 58 participants). Grey points are
individual ratings, jittered to reduce overlap. The dashed line marks the Not
asked mean. Consent responses were chosen by participants, so differences
between groups are correlational.
